import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AdjugateInversePrincipalField

/-!
# Relative principal fields of two genuine coordinate changes

The first two lemmas are the two-dimensional matrix identities for the
actual principal density.  The last lemma compares two physical fields
whose actual charts have the same canonical density.  It assumes neither
the desired relative coefficient identity nor a full operator identity.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology

private theorem principal_adjugate_cancel_scalar
    (a b c p q r s k t : ℝ) :
    t * ((k * (a * p ^ 2 + 2 * b * p * q + c * q ^ 2)) * s ^ 2 +
      2 * (k * (a * p * r + b * (p * s + q * r) + c * q * s)) * s * (-q) +
      (k * (a * r ^ 2 + 2 * b * r * s + c * s ^ 2)) * (-q) ^ 2) =
        (t * k * (p * s - r * q) ^ 2) * a ∧
    t * ((k * (a * p ^ 2 + 2 * b * p * q + c * q ^ 2)) * s * (-r) +
      (k * (a * p * r + b * (p * s + q * r) + c * q * s)) *
        (s * p + (-q) * (-r)) +
      (k * (a * r ^ 2 + 2 * b * r * s + c * s ^ 2)) * (-q) * p) =
        (t * k * (p * s - r * q) ^ 2) * b ∧
    t * ((k * (a * p ^ 2 + 2 * b * p * q + c * q ^ 2)) * (-r) ^ 2 +
      2 * (k * (a * p * r + b * (p * s + q * r) + c * q * s)) * (-r) * p +
      (k * (a * r ^ 2 + 2 * b * r * s + c * s ^ 2)) * p ^ 2) =
        (t * k * (p * s - r * q) ^ 2) * c := by
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> ring

/-- Pulling the actual principal density back through its own first
derivative recovers the physical coefficients. -/
theorem adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_of_density
    (A B : SymmetricCoefficients) (F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (h : PolarPoint → ℝ) (x : PolarPoint)
    (hJ : planeJacobian F x ≠ 0) (hh : h x ≠ 0)
    (ha : B.a (F x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A F h).a x)
    (hb : B.b (F x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A F h).b x)
    (hc : B.c (F x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A F h).c x) :
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).a x = A.a x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).b x = A.b x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).c x = A.c x := by
  have hfactor : (1 / (h x ^ 2 * |planeJacobian F x|)) *
      (h x ^ 2 / |planeJacobian F x|) * planeJacobian F x ^ 2 = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = h x ^ 2 * planeJacobian F x ^ 2 /
          (h x ^ 2 * |planeJacobian F x| ^ 2) := by
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, pow_two]
        ring
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        field_simp [hh, hJ]
  have hscalar := principal_adjugate_cancel_scalar
    (A.a x) (A.b x) (A.c x)
    (fderiv ℝ F x (1, 0)).1 (fderiv ℝ F x (0, 1)).1
    (fderiv ℝ F x (1, 0)).2 (fderiv ℝ F x (0, 1)).2
    (h x ^ 2 / |planeJacobian F x|) (1 / (h x ^ 2 * |planeJacobian F x|))
  have hfactor' : (1 / (h x ^ 2 * |planeJacobian F x|)) *
      (h x ^ 2 / |planeJacobian F x|) *
      ((fderiv ℝ F x (1, 0)).1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (0, 1)).2 -
        (fderiv ℝ F x (1, 0)).2 * (fderiv ℝ F x (0, 1)).1) ^ 2 = 1 := hfactor
  simp only [hfactor', one_mul] at hscalar
  simpa only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
    ha, hb, hc, coordinatePrincipalDensity] using hscalar

/-- The adjugate pullback composes with the product of the two actual
height factors.  No regularity of the coefficient functions is needed. -/
theorem adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_comp
    (A : SymmetricCoefficients) (F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (f g : PolarPoint → ℝ) (x : PolarPoint)
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (F x)) :
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A G g) F f).a x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A (G ∘ F)
          (fun y => f y * g (F y))).a x ∧
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A G g) F f).b x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A (G ∘ F)
          (fun y => f y * g (F y))).b x ∧
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A G g) F f).c x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A (G ∘ F)
          (fun y => f y * g (F y))).c x := by
  have hd (v : PolarPoint) : fderiv ℝ (G ∘ F) x v =
      ((fderiv ℝ F x v).1 * (fderiv ℝ G (F x) (1, 0)).1 +
          (fderiv ℝ F x v).2 * (fderiv ℝ G (F x) (0, 1)).1,
       (fderiv ℝ F x v).1 * (fderiv ℝ G (F x) (1, 0)).2 +
          (fderiv ℝ F x v).2 * (fderiv ℝ G (F x) (0, 1)).2) := by
    rw [fderiv_comp x hG hF, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact planeCLM_apply_decompose _ _
  have hJ := planeJacobian_comp hF hG
  constructor
  · simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
      hJ, hd, Function.comp_apply, abs_mul, mul_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
    ring
  constructor <;>
    simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
      hJ, hd, Function.comp_apply, abs_mul, mul_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev] <;> ring

private theorem adjugate_principal_congr_at
    (A B : SymmetricCoefficients) (F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (h : PolarPoint → ℝ) (x : PolarPoint)
    (ha : A.a (F x) = B.a (F x)) (hb : A.b (F x) = B.b (F x))
    (hc : A.c (F x) = B.c (F x)) :
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A F h).a x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).a x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A F h).b x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).b x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A F h).c x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F h).c x := by
  constructor
  · simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic, ha, hb, hc]
  constructor <;>
    simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic, ha, hb, hc]

/-- Equal canonical principal fields give the true reference physical
field under the relative map and the ratio of the actual heights. -/
theorem reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_of_common_density
    (A₀ A₁ B : SymmetricCoefficients)
    (F₀ F₁ τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (h₀ h₁ : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (x : PolarPoint)
    (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x) (hσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ (τ x))
    (hF₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ (τ x))
    (hinverse : σ ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint))
    (hchart : F₁ ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] F₀)
    (hJ₀ : planeJacobian F₀ x ≠ 0) (hJ₁ : planeJacobian F₁ (τ x) ≠ 0)
    (hh₀ : h₀ x ≠ 0) (hh₁ : h₁ (τ x) ≠ 0)
    (hA₀ : B.a (F₀ x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ F₀ h₀).a x ∧
      B.b (F₀ x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ F₀ h₀).b x ∧
      B.c (F₀ x) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ F₀ h₀).c x)
    (hA₁ : B.a (F₁ (τ x)) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ F₁ h₁).a (τ x) ∧
      B.b (F₁ (τ x)) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ F₁ h₁).b (τ x) ∧
      B.c (F₁ (τ x)) = (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ F₁ h₁).c (τ x)) :
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁ τ σ
      (fun y => h₀ y / h₁ (τ y))).a x = A₀.a x ∧
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁ τ σ
      (fun y => h₀ y / h₁ (τ y))).b x = A₀.b x ∧
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁ τ σ
      (fun y => h₀ y / h₁ (τ y))).c x = A₀.c x := by
  let q : PolarPoint → ℝ := fun y => h₀ y / h₁ (τ y)
  have hrec₀ := adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_of_density A₀ B F₀ h₀ x
    hJ₀ hh₀ hA₀.1 hA₀.2.1 hA₀.2.2
  have hrec₁ := adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_of_density A₁ B F₁ h₁ (τ x)
    hJ₁ hh₁ hA₁.1 hA₁.2.1 hA₁.2.2
  have hrev := reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_adjugate A₁
    (F := τ) (G := σ) (h := q) (x := x) hτ hσ
    hinverse (show q x ≠ 0 from div_ne_zero hh₀ hh₁)
  have hc := adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_comp B τ F₁ q h₁ x hτ hF₁
  have hq : q x * h₁ (τ x) = h₀ x := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hh₁
  have hd := hchart.fderiv_eq
  have hv := hchart.self_of_nhds
  have hJ : planeJacobian (F₁ ∘ τ) x = planeJacobian F₀ x := by
    simp only [planeJacobian, hd]
  have hvalues := adjugate_principal_congr_at
    (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F₁ h₁) A₁ τ q x
    hrec₁.1 hrec₁.2.1 hrec₁.2.2
  have hmatch :
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B (F₁ ∘ τ)
        (fun y => q y * h₁ (τ y))).a x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F₀ h₀).a x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B (F₁ ∘ τ)
        (fun y => q y * h₁ (τ y))).b x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F₀ h₀).b x ∧
      (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B (F₁ ∘ τ)
        (fun y => q y * h₁ (τ y))).c x =
        (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients B F₀ h₀).c x := by
    constructor
    · simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
        hd, hv, hJ, hq]
    constructor <;>
      simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
        hd, hv, hJ, hq]
  exact ⟨hrev.1.trans (hvalues.1.symm.trans (hc.1.trans (hmatch.1.trans hrec₀.1))),
    hrev.2.1.trans (hvalues.2.1.symm.trans (hc.2.1.trans (hmatch.2.1.trans hrec₀.2.1))),
    hrev.2.2.trans (hvalues.2.2.symm.trans (hc.2.2.trans (hmatch.2.2.trans hrec₀.2.2)))⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04bConstructedRootDensity
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.N04bActualAtlasGerms

/-!
# The actual negative atlas has the common Airy principal density

The coefficient factorization is computed from the corrected field.
The characteristic equations and positive angular derivatives come from
the actual forward flow and its actual inverse labels.  The stored atlas
has these chart and height germs on the whole open negative component.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_negativePrincipalDensity
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (k m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hi : e k = .inl (m, side)) {p : PolarPoint}
    (hp : p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).a p = 1 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).b p = 0 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z) (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).c p =
        -(K.chart z k p).1 := by
  let Φ : PolarPoint → ℝ := fun q => L.minusFlow z m q.1 q.2
  let hL : ℝ → ℝ := stateLeftChart S z.1 m
  let d : PolarPoint → ℝ := n04bCharacteristicDrift (L.coefficients z)
  let v : PolarPoint → ℝ := n04bCharacteristicHalfGap (L.coefficients z)
  let U : PolarPoint → ℝ := n04bPlusFirstIntegral Φ hL
  let V : PolarPoint → ℝ := n04bMinusFirstIntegral Φ hL
  have hΦ : N04bCircleFlowRegularity Φ (C.left m) (C.right m) Real.pi :=
    n04b_actualMinusFlow_regular hN hS hT hfield hz hs m
  have hLsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ hL :=
    stateLeftChart_contDiff S z m (hS.2.1 (3 / 4 : ℝ))
  have hleft := hN.1.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 z hz hs m
  have hLpos : ∀ θ, 0 < deriv hL θ :=
    fun θ => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) (hleft θ).1
  have hflowRaw := hN.2.2.2.2.2.1 z hz hs m
  have hflow : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m), ∀ θ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (s, θ))
        (d (r, Φ (r, θ)) - v (r, Φ (r, θ))) r :=
    fun r hr θ => (hflowRaw θ).2.2.1 r hr
  have hdodd : ∀ q ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
      d (q.1, -q.2) = -d q :=
    fun q _ => (n04b_actualCharacteristic_reflection hN hz hs q).1
  have hveven : ∀ q ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
      v (q.1, -q.2) = v q :=
    fun q _ => (n04b_actualCharacteristic_reflection hN hz hs q).2
  have hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U p :=
    ((n04b_plusFirstIntegral_smooth hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth).contDiffAt
      ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V p :=
    ((n04b_minusFirstIntegral_smooth hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth).contDiffAt
      ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hUr : radialPartial U p = -(d p + v p) * angularPartial U p :=
    n04b_plusFirstIntegral_transport hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth hflow hdodd hveven hp
  have hVr : radialPartial V p = -(d p - v p) * angularPartial V p :=
    n04b_minusFirstIntegral_transport hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth hflow hp
  have hUθ : 0 < angularPartial U p :=
    n04b_plusFirstIntegral_angularPartial_pos hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth hLpos hp
  have hVθ : 0 < angularPartial V p :=
    n04b_minusFirstIntegral_angularPartial_pos hΦ Real.pi_ne_zero hLsmooth hLpos hp
  have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
  have hpD : p ∈ annularOpen D :=
    ⟨⟨(hC.1 m).1.trans hp.1.1, hp.1.2.trans (hC.1 m).2.2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have ha := hfield.positive_a z hz hs p hpD
  have hv : 0 < v p := n04b_actualCharacteristic_halfGap_pos hN hfield hz hs m hp
  have hbc := n04b_characteristic_coefficients (L.coefficients z) ha.ne'
    (hfield.negative_discriminant z hz hs m p hp).le
  have horient : 0 < n04bTravelOrientation (C.travel m) side
      (characteristicTravelChart U V p).1 :=
    n04b_travelOrientation_pos_of_fullStrip side
      ((n04b_actualTravelChart_bijOn hN hS hT hfield hz hs m).mapsTo hp).1
  have hraw :
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
        (n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)
        (n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z) v
          (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)).a p = 1 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
        (n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)
        (n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z) v
          (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)).b p = 0 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity (L.coefficients z)
        (n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)
        (n04bRootPhysicalHeight (L.coefficients z) v
          (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m) (C.travel m) side)).c p =
          -(n04bRootPhysicalChart (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z m)
            (C.travel m) side p).1 :=
    n04b_coordinatePrincipalDensity_constructedRoot (L.coefficients z) d v
      (C.travel m) side hU hV hUr hVr hbc.1 hbc.2 ha hv hUθ hVθ horient
  have hg := n04bActualTypedAtlas_negative_component_germs
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs k m side hi hp
  have hD := hg.1.fderiv_eq
  have hh := hg.2.self_of_nhds
  have hpoint := hg.1.self_of_nhds
  simpa only [coordinatePrincipalDensity, coefficientQuadratic, planeJacobian,
    hD, hh, hpoint] using hraw

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.RelativePrincipalCoefficients
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.ActualNegativePrincipalDensity
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.CanonicalClosedTransport
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.StateNeighborhood

/-!
# Actual negative reference-to-current principal transport

Both states are compared through their genuine stored charts.  The common
Airy density is supplied by the actual characteristic construction, not
by assuming PartB or the desired relative coefficient match.  One Bool
parameter covers both root-adjacent negative halves.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem canonicalRelativePrincipal_eq_of_negative_densities
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {K : CanonicalData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (k : ℕ) (A₀ A₁ : SymmetricCoefficients)
    (hnormal₀ : ∀ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k,
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k)
        (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k)).a p = 1 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k)
        (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k)).b p = 0 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₀ (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k)
        (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k)).c p =
          -(K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k p).1)
    (hnormal₁ : ∀ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z k,
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).a p = 1 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).b p = 0 ∧
      (coordinatePrincipalDensity A₁ (K.chart z k) (K.height z k)).c p =
        -(K.chart z k p).1)
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k) :
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
      (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).a p = A₀.a p ∧
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
      (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).b p = A₀.b p ∧
    (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A₁
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
      (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).c p = A₀.c p := by
  let τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k
  let σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalReferencePoint C K z k
  have hcharts₀ := hA.charts (C.referenceState, 0) href hsref k
  have hcharts₁ := hA.charts z hz hs k
  have hU₀ : IsOpen (physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k) :=
    (hA.domains (C.referenceState, 0) href hsref k).1
  have hU₁ : IsOpen (physicalPieceOpen S K z k) := (hA.domains z hz hs k).1
  have hV : IsOpen (canonicalOpen S K k) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
  have hFp : K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k p ∈ canonicalOpen S K k := hcharts₀.1 hp
  have hx : τ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z k := hcharts₁.2.1 hFp
  have hFx : K.chart z k (τ p) = K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k p :=
    hcharts₁.2.2.2.1 _ hFp
  have hτ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ p :=
    n04Coordinates_currentPoint_contDiffAt_closed hA href hsref hz hs k (subset_closure hp)
  have hF₁ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (K.chart z k) (τ p) :=
    (hcharts₁.2.2.2.2.1 _ hx).contDiffAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hx)
  have hG₀ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (K.inverseChart (C.referenceState, 0) k)
      (K.chart z k (τ p)) := by
    rw [hFx]
    exact (hcharts₀.2.2.2.2.2.1 _ hFp).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hFp)
  have hσ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ σ (τ p) :=
    ContDiffAt.fun_comp (f := K.chart z k)
      (g := K.inverseChart (C.referenceState, 0) k) (τ p) hG₀ hF₁
  have hinverse : σ ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) :=
    n04Coordinates_referencePoint_currentPoint_germ hA href hsref hz hs k
      (subset_closure hp)
  have hchart : K.chart z k ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k := by
    filter_upwards [hU₀.mem_nhds hp] with y hy
    exact hcharts₁.2.2.2.1 _ (hcharts₀.1 hy)
  have hp₀ := hcharts₀.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 p hp
  have hp₁ := hcharts₁.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 (τ p) hx
  have hd₀ := hnormal₀ p hp
  have hd₁ := hnormal₁ (τ p) hx
  exact reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_of_common_density A₀ A₁
    canonicalAiryPrincipalCoefficients (K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k)
    (K.chart z k) τ σ (K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k) (K.height z k) p
    (hτ.differentiableAt (by simp)) (hσ.differentiableAt (by simp))
    (hF₁.differentiableAt (by simp)) hinverse hchart hp₀.2.1 hp₁.2.1
    hp₀.1.ne' hp₁.1.ne'
    ⟨hd₀.1.symm, hd₀.2.1.symm, hd₀.2.2.symm⟩
    ⟨hd₁.1.symm, hd₁.2.1.symm, hd₁.2.2.symm⟩

/-- The relative principal field equals the reference physical field on
each actual negative half.  Every normal-form input is constructed here. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativePrincipal_on_negative
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (k m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hi : e k = .inl (m, side)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    ∀ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k,
      (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).a p =
          (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)).a p ∧
      (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).b p =
          (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)).b p ∧
      (reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).c p =
          (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)).c p := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  have hK : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε :=
    n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e
  have href := reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  have hfull (w : AnnularState S × ℝ) {p : PolarPoint}
      (hp : p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K w k) :
      p ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := by
    apply n04b_typed_negative_domain_subset (D := D) (C := C)
      (Γ := n04bActualTravelChart S C L w) (m, side)
    simpa only [K, n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData_physicalPieceOpen, hi] using hp
  dsimp only
  intro p hp
  exact canonicalRelativePrincipal_eq_of_negative_densities hK href hsref hz hs k
    (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)) (L.coefficients z)
    (fun q hq => n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_negativePrincipalDensity
      hT hS hN hfield e href hsref k m side hi (hfull _ hq))
    (fun q hq => n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_negativePrincipalDensity
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs k m side hi (hfull _ hq)) hp

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Reference principal jets at the true negative roots

The adjugate expression uses only the actual forward relative map and
height ratio.  It is ordinarily smooth at the closed physical endpoints.
The proved equation on the open negative half therefore determines every
finite ordinary boundary jet.  No equation across the root is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem canonicalCurrentRelativeAdjugate_contDiffAt_closed
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {K : CanonicalData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hsref : stateSector S C.referenceState)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (k : ℕ) (A : SymmetricCoefficients)
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K (C.referenceState, 0) k)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.a (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k p))
    (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.b (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k p))
    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k p)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).a p ∧
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).b p ∧
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A
      (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)).c p := by
  have hτ := n04Coordinates_currentPoint_contDiffAt_closed hA href hsref hz hs k hp
  have hq := n04Coordinates_currentHeightRatio_contDiffAt_pos_closed hA href hsref hz hs k hp
  have hinv := canonicalCurrentPoint_closed_inverse_data hA href hsref hz hs k hp
  have hprod := planeJacobian_inverse_mul_of_germ
    (hτ.differentiableAt (by simp)) (hinv.1.differentiableAt (by simp)) hinv.2.1
  have hJ : planeJacobian (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hprod
    exact zero_ne_one hprod
  exact contDiffAt_adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
    (A := A) (F := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k)
    (h := n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k) ha hb hc hτ hq.1 hJ hq.2.ne'

private theorem typedNegative_closed_mem_annulus
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData} {C : NonlinearGeometryData S}
    (hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C) (Γ : ℕ → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) {p : PolarPoint}
    (hp : p ∈ closure (n04bTypedPhysicalDomain (D := D) C Γ (.inl (m, side)))) :
    p ∈ annularOpen D := by
  have hc := closure_mono (n04b_typed_negative_domain_subset
    (D := D) (C := C) (Γ := Γ) (m, side)) hp
  rw [closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo (hC.1 m).2.1.ne, closure_univ] at hc
  exact ⟨⟨(hC.1 m).1.trans_le hc.1.1, hc.1.2.trans_lt (hC.1 m).2.2⟩, mem_univ _⟩

/-- Every closed-half ordinary jet of the actual relative adjugate field
is the corresponding jet of the reference physical coefficient. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativeAdjugate_closed_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (k m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hi : e k = .inl (m, side)) {p : PolarPoint}
    (hp : p ∈ physicalPieceClosed S (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e)
      (C.referenceState, 0) k) (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k)
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k))) p =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
        (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0))) p := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let B := adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
    (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k)
  have hA : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε :=
    n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e
  have href := reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  have hcore (w : AnnularState S × ℝ) {q : PolarPoint}
      (hq : q ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K w k) : q ∈ annularOpen D := by
    apply typedNegative_closed_mem_annulus hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
      (n04bActualTravelChart S C L w) m side
    simpa only [physicalPieceClosed, K, n04bActualTypedAtlas,
      n04bTypedAtlasData_physicalPieceOpen, hi] using hq
  have hpD := hcore (C.referenceState, 0) hp
  have hx := n04Coordinates_currentPoint_mapsTo_closed hA href hsref hz hs k hp
  have hxD := hcore z hx
  have hreg₀ := hfield.smooth_coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) href hsref
  have hreg₁ := hfield.smooth_coefficients z hz hs
  have hnhds₀ := (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hpD
  have hnhds₁ := (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hxD
  have hB := canonicalCurrentRelativeAdjugate_contDiffAt_closed hA href hsref hz hs k
    (L.coefficients z) hp (hreg₁.1.contDiffAt hnhds₁)
    (hreg₁.2.1.contDiffAt hnhds₁) (hreg₁.2.2.contDiffAt hnhds₁)
  have hBi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (canonicalCoefficientComponent i B) p := by
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hB.1
    · exact hB.2.1
    · exact hB.2.2
  have hAi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0))) p := by
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hreg₀.1.contDiffAt hnhds₀
    · exact hreg₀.2.1.contDiffAt hnhds₀
    · exact hreg₀.2.2.contDiffAt hnhds₀
  have he : EqOn (canonicalCoefficientComponent i B)
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)))
      (physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k) := by
    intro q hq
    have hclosed : q ∈ physicalPieceClosed S K (C.referenceState, 0) k := subset_closure hq
    have hτ := n04Coordinates_currentPoint_contDiffAt_closed hA href hsref hz hs k hclosed
    have hqpos := n04Coordinates_currentHeightRatio_contDiffAt_pos_closed
      hA href hsref hz hs k hclosed
    have hinv := canonicalCurrentPoint_closed_inverse_data hA href hsref hz hs k hclosed
    have hr := reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_adjugate (L.coefficients z)
      (F := canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k) (G := canonicalReferencePoint C K z k)
      (h := n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k) (x := q)
      (hτ.differentiableAt (by simp)) (hinv.1.differentiableAt (by simp))
      hinv.2.1 hqpos.2.ne'
    have hn := n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativePrincipal_on_negative
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs k m side hi q hq
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hr.1.symm.trans hn.1
    · exact hr.2.1.symm.trans hn.2.1
    · exact hr.2.2.symm.trans hn.2.2
  exact iteratedFDeriv_eq_of_eqOn_open_of_mem_closure
    (hA.domains _ href hsref k).1 hp he hBi hAi n

/-- The same conclusion at either true component root, with the actual
paired atlas index and no additional boundary equation. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativeAdjugate_root_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    let k := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
    let c := if side then C.right m else C.left m
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) (canonicalCurrentPoint C K z k)
        (n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z k))) (c, θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
        (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0))) (c, θ) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let k := if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1
  have hA := n04b_actualTypedAtlas_partA hT hS hN hfield e
  have hcut := n04bActualTypedAtlas_cutGeometry hT hS hN hfield e
  have href := reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  have hi : e k = .inl (m, side) := by
    have hpair : K.cutPair m = (e.symm (.inl (m, false)), e.symm (.inl (m, true))) := rfl
    change e (if side then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1) = _
    rw [hpair]
    cases side <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hp := (canonicalCutRoot_mem_closed_and_zero hA hcut href hsref m side θ).1
  exact n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativeAdjugate_closed_jets
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs k m side hi hp i n

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Finite ordinary jets under actual smooth operations

The pointwise notion retains ordinary smoothness of the two actual
functions. Common smooth composition, pairing, and differentiation
preserve the appropriate finite order without a common infinite-order
neighborhood assumption.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open scoped ContDiff BigOperators

variable {E F G : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]

structure FiniteFullJetMatch (n : ℕ) (x : E) (f g : E → F) : Prop where
  left_smooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x
  right_smooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x
  jets : ∀ k, k ≤ n → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g x

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.value {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) : f x = g x := by
  have he := congrArg (fun A : E [×0]→L[ℝ] F => A (fun i => Fin.elim0 i))
    (h.jets 0 (Nat.zero_le n))
  simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply] using he

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.mono {m n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) (hmn : m ≤ n) : FiniteFullJetMatch m x f g :=
  ⟨h.left_smooth, h.right_smooth, fun k hk => h.jets k (hk.trans hmn)⟩

theorem finiteFullJetMatch_refl {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f : E → F}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x) : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f f :=
  ⟨hf, hf, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.comp {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F} {H : F → G}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) (hH : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (f x)) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n x (H ∘ f) (H ∘ g) := by
  have hHg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (g x) := h.value ▸ hH
  refine ⟨hH.comp x h.left_smooth, hHg.comp x h.right_smooth, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp hH h.left_smooth (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞),
    iteratedFDeriv_comp hHg h.right_smooth (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞)]
  unfold FormalMultilinearSeries.taylorComp
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  ext v
  simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.compAlongOrderedFinpartition_apply,
    OrderedFinpartition.applyOrderedFinpartition_apply, ftaylorSeries]
  rw [h.value]
  congr 1
  funext j
  rw [h.jets (c.partSize j) ((c.partSize_le j).trans hk)]

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.prodMk {n : ℕ} {x : E}
    {f g : E → F} {u v : E → G}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) (k : FiniteFullJetMatch n x u v) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n x (fun y => (f y, u y)) (fun y => (g y, v y)) := by
  refine ⟨h.left_smooth.prodMk k.left_smooth, h.right_smooth.prodMk k.right_smooth, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk h.left_smooth k.left_smooth (by simp : (j : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞),
    iteratedFDeriv_prodMk h.right_smooth k.right_smooth (by simp : (j : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞),
    h.jets j hj, k.jets j hj]

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.fderiv {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) x f g) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n x (fderiv ℝ f) (fderiv ℝ g) := by
  refine ⟨h.left_smooth.fderiv_right (by simp),
    h.right_smooth.fderiv_right (by simp), ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  ext v w
  have he := congrArg (fun A : E [×(k + 1)]→L[ℝ] F => A (Fin.snoc v w))
    (h.jets (k + 1) (Nat.add_le_add_right hk 1))
  simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right, Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last] using he

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Ordinary finite jets at an actual boundary

An equation on an adjacent open set reaches every finite ordinary jet
at a smooth closure point. Common precomposition then restricts these
jets to the actual radial curve, including its zero order.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff BigOperators

variable {E F G : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.symm {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) : FiniteFullJetMatch n x g f :=
  ⟨h.right_smooth, h.left_smooth, fun k hk => (h.jets k hk).symm⟩

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.trans {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g h : E → F}
    (hfg : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g) (hgh : FiniteFullJetMatch n x g h) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n x f h :=
  ⟨hfg.left_smooth, hgh.right_smooth,
    fun k hk => (hfg.jets k hk).trans (hgh.jets k hk)⟩

theorem finiteFullJetMatch_of_germ {n : ℕ} {x : E} {f g : E → F}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x)
    (he : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g :=
  ⟨hf, hg, fun k _ => (he.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds⟩

theorem finiteFullJetMatch_of_eqOn_closure
    {n : ℕ} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) {f g : E → F} {x : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x) (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g x)
    (he : EqOn f g U) (hx : x ∈ closure U) : FiniteFullJetMatch n x f g := by
  haveI : NeBot (𝓝[U] x) := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp hx
  refine ⟨hf, hg, ?_⟩
  intro k _
  have hfc : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f) x :=
    (hf.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (ENat.natCast_lt_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl k)).continuousAt
  have hgc : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k g) x :=
    (hg.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (ENat.natCast_lt_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl k)).continuousAt
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq
    (hfc.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) (hgc.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
    ((iteratedFDeriv_eqOn_of_isOpen hU he k).eventuallyEq_of_mem self_mem_nhdsWithin)

theorem FiniteFullJetMatch.precomp {n : ℕ} {y : E} {γ : E → F} {f g : F → G}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n (γ y) f g) (hγ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ γ y) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n y (f ∘ γ) (g ∘ γ) := by
  refine ⟨h.left_smooth.comp y hγ, h.right_smooth.comp y hγ, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp h.left_smooth hγ (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞),
    iteratedFDeriv_comp h.right_smooth hγ (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞)]
  unfold FormalMultilinearSeries.taylorComp
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  ext v
  simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.compAlongOrderedFinpartition_apply, ftaylorSeries]
  rw [h.jets c.length (c.length_le.trans hk)]

theorem radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_finiteFullJetMatch
    {f g : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c θ : ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n (c, θ) f g) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    radialBoundaryJet f c k θ = radialBoundaryJet g c k θ := by
  have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => (r, θ)) c :=
    contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const
  have hm := h.precomp hl
  have he := congrArg (fun A : ℝ [×k]→L[ℝ] ℝ => A (fun _ => 1)) (hm.jets k hk)
  simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, Function.comp_def] using he

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual adjugate principal jets from matched transport and height

The physical coefficient field is evaluated at the actual transported
point. Matching the transport through order n+1 and the height through
order n therefore matches the full ordinary principal jets through n.
The proof uses only the forward maps at the boundary.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped ContDiff

private abbrev PrincipalJetInput :=
  PolarPoint × ((PolarPoint →L[ℝ] PolarPoint) × ℝ)

private def principalJetFormula (A : SymmetricCoefficients) (i : Fin 3)
    (w : PrincipalJetInput) : ℝ :=
  let x := w.1
  let M := w.2.1
  let h := w.2.2
  let J := (M (1, 0)).1 * (M (0, 1)).2 - (M (1, 0)).2 * (M (0, 1)).1
  let s := 1 / (h ^ 2 * |J|)
  if i = 0 then s *
    (A.a x * (M (0, 1)).2 ^ 2 + 2 * A.b x * (M (0, 1)).2 * (-(M (0, 1)).1) +
      A.c x * (-(M (0, 1)).1) ^ 2)
  else if i = 1 then s *
    (A.a x * (M (0, 1)).2 * (-(M (1, 0)).2) +
      A.b x * ((M (0, 1)).2 * (M (1, 0)).1 +
        (-(M (0, 1)).1) * (-(M (1, 0)).2)) +
      A.c x * (-(M (0, 1)).1) * (M (1, 0)).1)
  else s *
    (A.a x * (-(M (1, 0)).2) ^ 2 +
      2 * A.b x * (-(M (1, 0)).2) * (M (1, 0)).1 +
      A.c x * (M (1, 0)).1 ^ 2)

private theorem contDiffAt_principalJetFormula
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {w : PrincipalJetInput}
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.a w.1) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.b w.1)
    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c w.1) (hh : w.2.2 ≠ 0)
    (hJ : (w.2.1 (1, 0)).1 * (w.2.1 (0, 1)).2 -
      (w.2.1 (1, 0)).2 * (w.2.1 (0, 1)).1 ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (principalJetFormula A i) w := by
  have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => v.2.1 (1, 0)) w :=
    contDiffAt_snd.fst.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
  have ht : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => v.2.1 (0, 1)) w :=
    contDiffAt_snd.fst.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
  have hdet := (hr.fst.mul ht.snd).sub (hr.snd.mul ht.fst)
  have hheight : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => v.2.2) w :=
    contDiffAt_snd.snd
  have hscale : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => 1 / (v.2.2 ^ 2 *
        |(v.2.1 (1, 0)).1 * (v.2.1 (0, 1)).2 -
          (v.2.1 (1, 0)).2 * (v.2.1 (0, 1)).1|)) w :=
    contDiffAt_const.fun_div ((hheight.pow 2).mul (hdet.abs hJ))
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hh) (abs_ne_zero.mpr hJ))
  have hAa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => A.a v.1) w :=
    ha.comp w contDiffAt_fst
  have hAb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => A.b v.1) w :=
    hb.comp w contDiffAt_fst
  have hAc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : PrincipalJetInput => A.c v.1) w :=
    hc.comp w contDiffAt_fst
  have htwo : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun _ : PrincipalJetInput => (2 : ℝ)) w :=
    contDiffAt_const
  unfold principalJetFormula
  split_ifs
  · exact hscale.mul (((hAa.mul (ht.snd.pow 2)).add
      (((htwo.mul hAb).mul ht.snd).mul ht.fst.neg)).add
        (hAc.mul (ht.fst.neg.pow 2)))
  · exact hscale.mul ((((hAa.mul ht.snd).mul hr.snd.neg).add
      (hAb.mul ((ht.snd.mul hr.fst).add (ht.fst.neg.mul hr.snd.neg)))).add
        ((hAc.mul ht.fst.neg).mul hr.fst))
  · exact hscale.mul (((hAa.mul (hr.snd.neg.pow 2)).add
      (((htwo.mul hAb).mul hr.snd.neg).mul hr.fst)).add
        (hAc.mul (hr.fst.pow 2)))

/-- Coordinate jets and height jets, not transformed coefficient jets,
are the inputs. All smoothness assumptions are ordinary at the actual
point, including the transported physical coefficient point. -/
theorem finiteFullJetMatch_adjugatePrincipal
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {h q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint} {n : ℕ}
    (hFG : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) p F G)
    (hhq : FiniteFullJetMatch n p h q)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.a (F p)) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.b (F p))
    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c (F p))
    (hh : h p ≠ 0) (hJ : planeJacobian F p ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n p
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A F h))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A G q)) := by
  have hinput := (hFG.mono (Nat.le_succ n)).prodMk (hFG.fderiv.prodMk hhq)
  have houter : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (principalJetFormula A i)
      (F p, (fderiv ℝ F p, h p)) :=
    contDiffAt_principalJetFormula ha hb hc hh hJ i
  have he (T : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (v : PolarPoint → ℝ) :
      canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A T v) =
        principalJetFormula A i ∘ (fun x => (T x, (fderiv ℝ T x, v x))) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_def, principalJetFormula, canonicalCoefficientComponent,
      ite_apply, adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic, planeJacobian]
  rw [he F h, he G q]
  exact hinput.comp houter

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual positive principal jets at a negative neighbor

The genuine inverse-chart field equals its forward adjugate formula.
The existing coordinate and height matching therefore transfers full
principal jets from the actual neighboring negative transport. No
coefficient matching or vanishing remainder is an input.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients_eq_reverse
    (A : SymmetricCoefficients) (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ) :
    wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q =
      reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A τ σ Q := by
  simp only [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients, reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients,
    wholePositiveChartHeight, one_div]

theorem wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient_component_eq_adjugate
    (A : SymmetricCoefficients) {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    canonicalCoefficientComponent i (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q) =
      canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A τ Q) := by
  funext p
  have hQ : 0 < (Q p)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [wholePositiveChartHeight, H.right_inverse p] using
      H.height_positive (τ p)
  have hi : σ ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall H.right_inverse
  have he := reverseCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_eq_adjugate A
    (F := τ) (G := σ) (h := Q) (x := p)
    (H.inverse_smooth.differentiable (by simp) p)
    (H.chart_smooth.differentiable (by simp) (τ p)) hi (inv_pos.mp hQ).ne'
  rw [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients_eq_reverse]
  simp only [canonicalCoefficientComponent, ite_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact he.1
  · exact he.2.1
  · exact he.2.2

/-- This consumes the already constructed coordinate and height jets;
the output concerns the actual inverse-chart coefficient function. -/
theorem finiteFullJetMatch_wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {T τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {q Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint} {n : ℕ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    (hTτ : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) p T τ)
    (hqQ : FiniteFullJetMatch n p q Q)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.a (T p)) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.b (T p))
    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c (T p))
    (hq : q p ≠ 0) (hJ : planeJacobian T p ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n p
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A T q))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent i (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q)) := by
  rw [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient_component_eq_adjugate A H i]
  exact finiteFullJetMatch_adjugatePrincipal hTτ hqQ ha hb hc hq hJ i

/-- The true negative index and the coefficient evaluation point come
from the actual atlas and its closed-component range. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_negative_root_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)}
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d J H : ℝ}
    (hm : WholePositiveTransportMatching n
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      τ σ Q (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) c d J H)
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hadj : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) = (if side then C.right m else C.left m))
    (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    FiniteFullJetMatch n (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m)
        (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m)))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) τ σ Q)) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let p : PolarPoint := (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)
  have hends := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1.1 m
  have hp : p ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨?_, mem_univ _⟩
    cases side
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, hends.2.1.le⟩
    · exact ⟨hends.2.1.le, le_rfl⟩
  have hreg := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_closed_regular
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m (p := p) hp
  have hj := wholePositiveTransportMatching_negative_root_jets hN.1.1 j hm
  have hTτ : FiniteFullJetMatch (n + 1) p
      (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) τ :=
    ⟨hreg.1, hm.geometry.smooth.contDiffAt,
      fun k hk => (hj m side hadj).1 θ k hk⟩
  have hqQ : FiniteFullJetMatch n p
      (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m) Q :=
    ⟨hreg.2.1, hm.height_smooth.contDiffAt,
      fun k hk => (hj m side hadj).2 θ k hk⟩
  have hJ : planeJacobian (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) p ≠ 0 := by
    have hpos : 0 < planeJacobian (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m) p := by
      simpa only [planeJacobian, hTτ.fderiv.value] using hm.geometry.jacobian_positive p
    exact hpos.ne'
  have himage := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_mapsTo_closed
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m (x := p) hp
  have hcore : canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p ∈ annularOpen D :=
    ⟨⟨hends.1.trans_le himage.1.1, himage.1.2.trans_lt hends.2.2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hnhds : annularOpen D ∈ 𝓝 (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p) :=
    (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hcore
  have hA := hfield.smooth_coefficients z hz hs
  exact finiteFullJetMatch_wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficient
    (wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_matching hm) hTτ hqQ
    (hA.1.contDiffAt hnhds) (hA.2.1.contDiffAt hnhds) (hA.2.2.contDiffAt hnhds)
    hreg.2.2.ne' hJ v

theorem radialBoundaryJet_sub_eq_zero_of_finiteFullJetMatch
    {f g : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c θ : ℝ} {n k : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteFullJetMatch n (c, θ) f g) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    radialBoundaryJet (fun p => f p - g p) c k θ = 0 := by
  have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => (r, θ)) c :=
    contDiffAt_id.prodMk contDiffAt_const
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => f (r, θ)) c :=
    h.left_smooth.comp c hl
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => g (r, θ)) c :=
    h.right_smooth.comp c hl
  change iteratedDeriv k (fun r : ℝ => f (r, θ) - g (r, θ)) c = 0
  rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
    (hf.of_le (show (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ by simp))
    (hg.of_le (show (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ by simp))]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_finiteFullJetMatch h hk)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# The actual positive principal difference vanishes to the matched order

The true whole negative root germ carries the proved reference principal
equation. The constructed positive coordinate and height jets transfer
that equation to the actual inverse-chart coefficient field. Interior
positive endpoints use their genuine negative neighbors; ambient endpoints
are explicitly excluded from this conclusion.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_component_eventuallyEq
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {h g : PolarPoint → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hF : F =ᶠ[𝓝 p] G) (hh : h =ᶠ[𝓝 p] g) (i : Fin 3) :
    canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A F h) =ᶠ[𝓝 p]
      canonicalCoefficientComponent i (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients A G g) := by
  have hD : fderiv ℝ F =ᶠ[𝓝 p] fderiv ℝ G := hF.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [hF, hD, hh] with q hpoint hderiv hheight
  unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
  split_ifs <;>
    simp only [adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients, coefficientQuadratic,
      planeJacobian, hpoint, hderiv, hheight]

variable {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
  {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
  (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
  (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
  {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
  (hs : stateSector S z.1)

include hT hS hN hfield e hz hs

/-- The whole-component negative selector has the same genuine root
germ as its stored endpoint field. Thus all reference principal jets
already proved for that field also hold for this actual selector. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholeNegativePrincipal_reference_root_jets
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m)
        (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m)))
        (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k
        (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)))
        (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) := by
  have hg := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_root_germs hT hS hN hfield e
    (z := z) m side θ
  have hcoeff := adjugateCoordinatePrincipalCoefficients_component_eventuallyEq
    (A := L.coefficients z) hg.1 hg.2 v
  exact (hcoeff.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds.trans
    (n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_relativeAdjugate_root_jets
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m side θ v k)

variable {n : ℕ} {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)}
  (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
  {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d J H : ℝ}
  (hm : WholePositiveTransportMatching n
    (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
    (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
    τ σ Q (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) c d J H)

include j hm

/-- The positive field is compared to the original reference physical
coefficients. No unit principal field or coefficient-jet premise occurs. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_reference_root_jets
    (m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hadj : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) = (if side then C.right m else C.left m))
    (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) τ σ Q))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0))) := by
  have hmatch := n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_negative_root_jets
    hT hS hN hfield e hz hs j hm m side hadj θ v
  have hends := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1.1 m
  have hp : (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) ∈ annularOpen D := by
    refine ⟨?_, mem_univ _⟩
    cases side
    · exact ⟨hends.1, hends.2.1.trans hends.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hends.1.trans hends.2.1, hends.2.2⟩
  have href := reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  have hA := hfield.smooth_coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) href hsref
  have hnhds := (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hp
  have hAi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)))
      (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) := by
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hA.1.contDiffAt hnhds
    · exact hA.2.1.contDiffAt hnhds
    · exact hA.2.2.contDiffAt hnhds
  refine ⟨hmatch.right_smooth, hAi, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  exact (hmatch.jets k hk).symm.trans
    (n04Coordinates_wholeNegativePrincipal_reference_root_jets
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m side θ v k)

/-- The neighbor is supplied by the actual reference partition, not by
an additional principal matching assumption. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_interior_endpoint_jets
    (side : Bool)
    (hinterior : n04PositiveEndpoint i side ≠ (if side then D.b else D.a))
    (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) :
    FiniteFullJetMatch n (n04PositiveEndpoint i side, θ)
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients
        (L.coefficients z) τ σ Q))
      (canonicalCoefficientComponent v (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hadj⟩ := n04PositiveEndpoint_exists_negative_neighbor
    (n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN) hN.1.1.2.2.2.1 i side hinterior
  have hadj' : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!(!side)) =
      (if !side then C.right m else C.left m) := by
    cases side <;> exact hadj
  have hpoint : (if !side then C.right m else C.left m) =
      n04PositiveEndpoint i side := by
    cases side <;> exact hadj.symm
  simpa only [hpoint] using
    (n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_reference_root_jets
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs j hm m (!side) hadj' θ v)

/-- In particular, matching coordinate jets through order three and
height jets through order two gives the three genuine zero radial jets. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_difference_endpoint_jets
    (side : Bool)
    (hinterior : n04PositiveEndpoint i side ≠ (if side then D.b else D.a))
    (θ : ℝ) (v : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    radialBoundaryJet
      (fun p => canonicalCoefficientComponent v
        (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients (L.coefficients z) τ σ Q) p -
          canonicalCoefficientComponent v (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)) p)
      (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) k θ = 0 :=
  radialBoundaryJet_sub_eq_zero_of_finiteFullJetMatch
    (n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_interior_endpoint_jets
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs j hm side hinterior θ v) hk

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# A genuine smooth representative of the positive principal difference

For a whole positive component whose two endpoints lie in the physical
annulus, only the physical coefficient fields are cut off. The displayed
transport, inverse and height remain unchanged. The resulting global
smooth difference agrees with the actual difference as a joint germ on
the entire closed component, so all its true endpoint jets are retained.

No unit determinant, unit principal field or vanishing jet is an input.
Ambient endpoints are not covered by this buffered extension lemma.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

private theorem wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth
    {χ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} {f : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hs : tsupport χ ⊆ Ioo a b)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => χ p.1 * f p) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ tsupport χ
  · exact (hχ.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffAt.mul
      (hf.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨hs hp, mem_univ _⟩))
  · have hz := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hp).comp_tendsto
      (continuous_fst.tendsto p)
    have he : (fun q : PolarPoint => χ q.1 * f q) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hz] with q hq
      have hq' : χ q.1 = 0 := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hq
      simp only [hq', zero_mul]
    exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq he

/-- The extension preserves the actual difference, not a replacement
normal form. The cutoff is applied before the genuine coordinate map. -/
theorem exists_wholePositivePrincipal_difference_extension
    {A Aref : SymmetricCoefficients} {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {a l r b c d : ℝ}
    (hal : a < l) (hlr : l < r) (hrb : r < b)
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A.a (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A.b (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A.c (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (ha₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Aref.a (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hb₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Aref.b (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hc₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Aref.c (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))) :
    ∃ F : Fin 3 → PolarPoint → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F i)) ∧
      ∀ i p, p ∈ Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) →
        F i =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun q =>
          canonicalCoefficientComponent i (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q) q -
            canonicalCoefficientComponent i Aref q) := by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hsupport, hone⟩ := exists_bufferedRadialCutoff hal hlr.le hrb
  let Aext : SymmetricCoefficients :=
    ⟨fun p => χ p.1 * A.a p, fun p => χ p.1 * A.b p, fun p => χ p.1 * A.c p⟩
  let Arefext : SymmetricCoefficients :=
    ⟨fun p => χ p.1 * Aref.a p, fun p => χ p.1 * Aref.b p,
      fun p => χ p.1 * Aref.c p⟩
  have hAe : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Aext.a ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ Aext.b ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ Aext.c :=
    ⟨wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport ha,
      wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport hb,
      wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport hc⟩
  have hAre : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Arefext.a ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ Arefext.b ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Arefext.c :=
    ⟨wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport ha₀,
      wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport hb₀,
      wholePositive_cutoff_mul_smooth hχ hsupport hc₀⟩
  let B := wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients Aext τ σ Q
  have hD (p : PolarPoint) := contDiffAt_coordinatePrincipalDensity
    (hAe.1.contDiffAt (x := p)) hAe.2.1.contDiffAt hAe.2.2.contDiffAt
    H.chart_smooth.contDiffAt H.height_smooth.contDiffAt (H.jacobian_positive p).ne'
  have hBa : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B.a :=
    (contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr fun p => (hD p).1).comp H.inverse_smooth
  have hBb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B.b :=
    (contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr fun p => (hD p).2.1).comp H.inverse_smooth
  have hBc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B.c :=
    (contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr fun p => (hD p).2.2).comp H.inverse_smooth
  have hBi (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (canonicalCoefficientComponent i B) := by
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hBa
    · exact hBb
    · exact hBc
  have hAri (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (canonicalCoefficientComponent i Arefext) := by
    unfold canonicalCoefficientComponent
    split_ifs
    · exact hAre.1
    · exact hAre.2.1
    · exact hAre.2.2
  refine ⟨fun i q => canonicalCoefficientComponent i B q -
    canonicalCoefficientComponent i Arefext q, fun i => (hBi i).sub (hAri i), ?_⟩
  intro i p hp
  have hcurrent := (hone (τ p).1 (H.inverse_maps_closed (x := p) hp).1).comp_tendsto
    (H.inverse_smooth.continuous.fst.tendsto p)
  have hreference := (hone p.1 hp.1).comp_tendsto (continuous_fst.tendsto p)
  filter_upwards [hcurrent, hreference] with q hq hq₀
  have hq' : χ (τ q).1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.one_apply] using hq
  have hq₀' : χ q.1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.one_apply] using hq₀
  simp only [B, Aext, Arefext, wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients,
    inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients, coordinatePrincipalDensity,
    canonicalCoefficientComponent, ite_apply, coefficientQuadratic, hq', hq₀', one_mul]

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Cubic division of an actual field with a smooth representative

A global smooth representative is used only to define the removable
quotient. Its genuine germs on the closed cylinder retain all jets of
the actual field. The factorization and the fixed-loss mixed estimate
therefore refer to that actual field, including both boundary circles.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem contDiff_intervalRadialCubicQuotient
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) {l r : ℝ} (hlr : l < r)
    (hleft : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) l = 0)
    (hright : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) r = 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (intervalRadialCubicQuotient F l r) := by
  let G := translateRadialField l F
  have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G :=
    hF.comp ((contDiff_const.add contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)
  have hGl : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => G (x, θ)) 0 = 0 := by
    intro θ k hk
    calc
      iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => G (x, θ)) 0 =
          iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) (l + 0) :=
        congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) l) 0
      _ = 0 := by simpa only [add_zero] using hleft θ k hk
  have hGr : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 →
      iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => G (x, θ)) (r - l) = 0 := by
    intro θ k hk
    have hsum : l + (r - l) = r := by ring
    calc
      iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => G (x, θ)) (r - l) =
          iteratedDeriv k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) (l + (r - l)) :=
        congrFun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add k (fun x : ℝ => F (x, θ)) l) (r - l)
      _ = 0 := by simpa only [hsum] using hright θ k hk
  exact (contDiff_radialTwoEndpointCubicQuotient hG (sub_pos.mpr hlr) hGl hGr).comp
    ((contDiff_const.add contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)

/-- Both boundary factors are genuinely removable. The bound loses six
radial derivatives, no angular derivatives, and has constant one over 36. -/
theorem intervalRadialCubicQuotient_of_closed_germs
    {F f : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r : ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hlr : l < r)
    (he : ∀ p ∈ Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), F =ᶠ[𝓝 p] f)
    (hleft : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → radialBoundaryJet f l k θ = 0)
    (hright : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → radialBoundaryJet f r k θ = 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (intervalRadialCubicQuotient F l r) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
        f p = ((p.1 - l) * (r - p.1)) ^ 3 * intervalRadialCubicQuotient F l r p) ∧
      ∀ a b : ℕ, ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
        (∀ x ∈ Icc l r, |mixedDerivative (a + 6) b f (x, p.2)| ≤ M) →
        |mixedDerivative a b (intervalRadialCubicQuotient F l r) p| ≤ M / 36 := by
  have hFjet (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc l r)
      (hzero : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → radialBoundaryJet f x k θ = 0) :
      ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 → iteratedDeriv k (fun t : ℝ => F (t, θ)) x = 0 := by
    intro θ k hk
    have hg := (he (x, θ) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩).comp_tendsto
      ((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).tendsto x)
    exact (hg.iteratedDeriv k).eq_of_nhds.trans (hzero θ k hk)
  have hFl := hFjet l ⟨le_rfl, hlr.le⟩ hleft
  have hFr := hFjet r ⟨hlr.le, le_rfl⟩ hright
  refine ⟨contDiff_intervalRadialCubicQuotient hF hlr hFl hFr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    by_cases hpl : p.1 = l
    · have hp' : p = (l, p.2) := Prod.ext hpl rfl
      have hz : f (l, p.2) = 0 := by
        simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hleft p.2 0 (by decide)
      rw [hp']
      simp only [hz, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_pow (by decide : 3 ≠ 0)]
    by_cases hpr : p.1 = r
    · have hp' : p = (r, p.2) := Prod.ext hpr rfl
      have hz : f (r, p.2) = 0 := by
        simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hright p.2 0 (by decide)
      rw [hp']
      simp only [hz, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 3 ≠ 0), zero_mul]
    have hpin : p.1 ∈ Ioo l r :=
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hp.1.1 (Ne.symm hpl), lt_of_le_of_ne hp.1.2 hpr⟩
    have hden : ((p.1 - l) * (r - p.1)) ^ 3 ≠ 0 :=
      pow_ne_zero 3 (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hpin.1) (sub_pos.mpr hpin.2)).ne'
    have hfactor := (eq_div_iff hden).mp
      (intervalRadialCubicQuotient_eq_div F (p := p) hpin)
    calc
      f p = F p := (he p hp).eq_of_nhds.symm
      _ = intervalRadialCubicQuotient F l r p * ((p.1 - l) * (r - p.1)) ^ 3 := hfactor.symm
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  · intro a b M p hp hbound
    apply abs_mixedDerivative_intervalRadialCubicQuotient_le hF hlr hFl hFr a b
      (p := p) ?_ hp.1
    intro x hx
    rw [mixedDerivative_eq_of_germ (he (x, p.2) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩) (a + 6) b]
    exact hbound x hx

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual cubic principal differences on an interior positive component

The numerator is the displayed positive chart's actual coefficient minus
the original physical reference coefficient. Its three zero endpoint
jets are consequences of the actual negative operator identity and the
constructed transport matching. A smooth representative supplies the
removable quotient and its fixed six-derivative estimate.

The component is buffered inside the annulus. This statement does not
claim the separate ambient-endpoint case or a material numerator bound.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

def wholePositivePrincipalDifference (A Aref : SymmetricCoefficients)
    (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ) (v : Fin 3)
    (p : PolarPoint) : ℝ :=
  canonicalCoefficientComponent v (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q) p -
    canonicalCoefficientComponent v Aref p

/-- The actual whole-positive field admits cubic division through both
true roots, with a globally smooth quotient representative. The mixed
estimate is expressed in the actual numerator, not the cutoff field. -/
theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_cubic_difference
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1)
    {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)}
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d J H : ℝ}
    (hm : WholePositiveTransportMatching n
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e) z)
      τ σ Q (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) c d J H)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hl : D.a < n04PositiveLeft i) (hr : n04PositiveRight i < D.b) :
    ∃ divided : Fin 3 → PolarPoint → ℝ,
      (∀ v, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (divided v)) ∧
      (∀ v p, p ∈ Icc (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) →
        wholePositivePrincipalDifference (L.coefficients z)
            (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)) τ σ Q v p =
          ((p.1 - n04PositiveLeft i) * (n04PositiveRight i - p.1)) ^ 3 * divided v p) ∧
      ∀ v (a b : ℕ) (M : ℝ) p,
        p ∈ Icc (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) →
        (∀ x ∈ Icc (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i),
          |mixedDerivative (a + 6) b
            (wholePositivePrincipalDifference (L.coefficients z)
              (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)) τ σ Q v) (x, p.2)| ≤ M) →
        |mixedDerivative a b (divided v) p| ≤ M / 36 := by
  have hD := n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (deriv D.w) := hD.2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  have hlr := (n04PositiveComponent_bounds hcontinuous i).2.1
  have href := reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1
  have hsref := hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector
  have hA := hfield.smooth_coefficients z hz hs
  have hAref := hfield.smooth_coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) href hsref
  obtain ⟨F, hF, he⟩ := exists_wholePositivePrincipal_difference_extension
    hl hlr hr (wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_matching hm)
    hA.1 hA.2.1 hA.2.2 hAref.1 hAref.2.1 hAref.2.2
  let f := wholePositivePrincipalDifference (L.coefficients z)
    (L.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0)) τ σ Q
  have hzero (side : Bool) (v : Fin 3) (θ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) :
      radialBoundaryJet (f v) (n04PositiveEndpoint i side) k θ = 0 := by
    have hinterior : n04PositiveEndpoint i side ≠ (if side then D.b else D.a) := by
      cases side
      · exact ne_of_gt hl
      · exact ne_of_lt hr
    exact n04Coordinates_wholePositivePrincipal_difference_endpoint_jets
      hT hS hN hfield e hz hs j hm side hinterior θ v k (hk.trans hn)
  have hleft (v : Fin 3) : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 →
      radialBoundaryJet (f v) (n04PositiveLeft i) k θ = 0 := by
    intro θ k hk
    simpa only [n04PositiveEndpoint, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using
      hzero false v θ k hk
  have hright (v : Fin 3) : ∀ θ k, k ≤ 2 →
      radialBoundaryJet (f v) (n04PositiveRight i) k θ = 0 := by
    intro θ k hk
    simpa only [n04PositiveEndpoint, ↓reduceIte] using hzero true v θ k hk
  have hout (v : Fin 3) := intervalRadialCubicQuotient_of_closed_germs
    (f := f v) (hF v) hlr (he v) (hleft v) (hright v)
  refine ⟨fun v => intervalRadialCubicQuotient (F v)
    (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i), fun v => (hout v).1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v p hp
    exact (hout v).2.1 p hp
  · intro v a b M p hp hbound
    exact (hout v).2.2 a b M p hp hbound

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis
