/-!
# One atlas with the retained negative halves and whole positive pieces

One enumeration indexes all fields. Negative pieces retain the actual
stored charts, domains, heights and operator fields of the supplied atlas.
Positive pieces use the constructed inverse transport and relative height.
The existing interior-division constructor supplies the actual quotient.
The positive material labels and normalization region are chosen once by
the reference construction and remain explicit data here.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

def n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ) : CanonicalData S :=
  let neg : ℕ × Bool → ℕ := fun j =>
    if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
  let B : CanonicalData S := {
    left := fun m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.left (neg j)
      | .inr i => n04PositiveLeft i
    right := fun m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.right (neg j)
      | .inr i => n04PositiveRight i
    physicalLeft := fun m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.physicalLeft (neg j)
      | .inr i => n04PositiveLeft i
    physicalRight := fun m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.physicalRight (neg j)
      | .inr i => n04PositiveRight i
    physicalDomain := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.physicalDomain z (neg j)
      | .inr i => Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ univ
    cell := fun m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.cell (neg j)
      | .inr i => cell i
    positive := fun m => n04WholePiecePositive (e m)
    chart := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.chart z (neg j)
      | .inr i => F z i
    inverseChart := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.inverseChart z (neg j)
      | .inr i => G z i
    height := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.height z (neg j)
      | .inr i => wholePositiveChartHeight (F z i) (Q z i)
    coefficients := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.coefficients z (neg j)
      | .inr i => wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
          (G z i) (F z i) (Q z i)
    potential := fun z m => match e m with
      | .inl j => K.potential z (neg j)
      | .inr i => wholePositiveCanonicalPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (G z i) (F z i) (Q z i)
    dividedDifference := fun _ _ => ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩
    cutPair := n04WholeCutPair e
    cutRadius := K.cutRadius
    normalizationRegion := N }
  n04bWithInteriorDivision C B

variable {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
  (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ)

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_negative_fields
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) (j : ℕ × Bool) (hi : e m = .inl j) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    let k := if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
    W.left m = K.left k ∧ W.right m = K.right k ∧
      W.physicalLeft m = K.physicalLeft k ∧ W.physicalRight m = K.physicalRight k ∧
      physicalPieceOpen S W z m = physicalPieceOpen S K z k ∧
      W.cell m = K.cell k ∧ W.positive m = false ∧
      W.chart z m = K.chart z k ∧ W.inverseChart z m = K.inverseChart z k ∧
      W.height z m = K.height z k ∧ W.coefficients z m = K.coefficients z k ∧
      W.potential z m = K.potential z k := by
  simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
    physicalPieceOpen, n04WholePiecePositive, hi, and_self]

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_positive_fields
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)) (hi : e m = .inr i) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.left m = n04PositiveLeft i ∧ W.right m = n04PositiveRight i ∧
      W.physicalLeft m = n04PositiveLeft i ∧ W.physicalRight m = n04PositiveRight i ∧
      physicalPieceOpen S W z m =
        Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) ∧
      W.cell m = cell i ∧ W.positive m = true ∧
      W.chart z m = F z i ∧ W.inverseChart z m = G z i ∧
      W.height z m = wholePositiveChartHeight (F z i) (Q z i) ∧
      W.coefficients z m = wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (G z i) (F z i) (Q z i) ∧
      W.potential z m = wholePositiveCanonicalPotential (L.coefficients z)
        (G z i) (F z i) (Q z i) := by
  simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
    physicalPieceOpen, n04WholePiecePositive, hi, and_self]

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_cut_metadata :
    (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).cutPair = n04WholeCutPair e ∧
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).cutRadius = K.cutRadius ∧
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N).normalizationRegion = N :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The frozen coefficient factorization is the existing interior quotient
of this very record, before any endpoint estimates are asserted. -/
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_factorization
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint)
    (hp : p ∈ canonicalOpen S (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N) m) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    let d := (p.1 - W.left m) * (W.right m - p.1)
    (W.coefficients z m).a p - (W.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) m).a p =
        d ^ 3 * (W.dividedDifference z m).a p ∧
    (W.coefficients z m).b p - (W.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) m).b p =
        d ^ 3 * (W.dividedDifference z m).b p ∧
    (W.coefficients z m).c p - (W.coefficients (C.referenceState, 0) m).c p =
        d ^ 3 * (W.dividedDifference z m).c p :=
  n04bWithInteriorDivision_factorization C
    (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N) z m hp

/-- Reference identity and the actual inverse law identify the stored
positive relative fields with the transport and height originally chosen. -/
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_positive_relative_fields
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)) (hi : e m = .inr i)
    (hFref : F (C.referenceState, 0) i = id)
    (hQref : Q (C.referenceState, 0) i = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse (F z i) (G z i)) :
    canonicalCurrentPoint C (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N) z m =
        G z i ∧
      n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C
        (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N) z m = Q z i := by
  constructor
  · funext p
    simp only [canonicalCurrentPoint, n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData,
      n04bWithInteriorDivision, hi, hFref, id_eq]
  · funext p
    simp only [n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio, canonicalCurrentPoint,
      n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision, hi,
      wholePositiveChartHeight, hFref, hQref, id_eq, hleft,
      inv_one, one_div, inv_inv]

/-!
# Normalization on the actual middle of each positive component

Disjointness of the genuine positive components puts every normalization
point in its own buffer. The already constructed middle germs then give
the same chart and height for any two members of the family.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer.mem_middle_of_mem_region
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {K : Set ℝ}
    (B : N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer a b f K) (hf : Continuous f)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent a b f) {r : ℝ}
    (hi : r ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i))
    (hr : r ∈ B.region) : r ∈ Icc (B.centerLeft i) (B.centerRight i) := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hr
  have ho := B.ordered j
  have hrj : r ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft j) (n04PositiveRight j) :=
    ⟨(ho.1.trans ho.2.1).trans hj.1,
      hj.2.trans (ho.2.2.2.1.trans ho.2.2.2.2)⟩
  have hij : i = j := by
    by_contra hne
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (n04PositiveComponent_interval_pairwiseDisjoint hf hne) hi hrj
  subst j
  exact ⟨(ho.2.1.trans hj.1).le, (hj.2.trans ho.2.2.2.1).le⟩

theorem N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer.chart_height_normalization
    {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {K : Set ℝ}
    (B : N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer a b f K) (hf : Continuous f)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent a b f)
    {F G F₀ G₀ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h h₀ : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry F G h
      (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) (B.centerLeft i) (B.centerRight i))
    (H₀ : WholePositiveChartGeometry F₀ G₀ h₀
      (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) (B.centerLeft i) (B.centerRight i))
    {p : PolarPoint}
    (hp : p ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
    (hn : p.1 ∈ B.region) : F p = F₀ p ∧ h p = h₀ p := by
  have hm := B.mem_middle_of_mem_region hf i hp.1 hn
  have hnow := H.normalization_on_middle hm
  have href := H₀.normalization_on_middle hm
  exact ⟨hnow.1.trans href.1.symm, hnow.2.2.trans href.2.2.symm⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

include hK hz hs hpositive in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_charts (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    MapsTo (W.chart z m) (physicalPieceOpen S W z m) (canonicalOpen S W m) ∧
    MapsTo (W.inverseChart z m) (canonicalOpen S W m) (physicalPieceOpen S W z m) ∧

    (∀ p ∈ canonicalOpen S W m, W.chart z m (W.inverseChart z m p) = p) ∧

    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W.inverseChart z m) (canonicalOpen S W m) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W.height z m) (physicalPieceOpen S W z m) ∧

      0 < W.height z m p ∧ planeJacobian (W.chart z m) p ≠ 0 ∧
      W.chart z m (p + (0, Real.pi)) = W.chart z m p + (0, Real.pi) ∧
      W.height z m (p + (0, Real.pi)) = W.height z m p) := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,

include hK hz hs hpositive in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_boundary
    (hf : Continuous (deriv D.w)) (m : ℕ) :

    MapsTo (W.chart z m) (physicalPieceClosed S W z m) (canonicalClosed S W m) ∧
    MapsTo (W.inverseChart z m) (canonicalClosed S W m) (physicalPieceClosed S W z m) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ physicalPieceClosed S W z m, W.inverseChart z m (W.chart z m p) = p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ canonicalClosed S W m, W.chart z m (W.inverseChart z m p) = p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ physicalPieceClosed S W z m,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (W.chart z m) p ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (W.height z m) p ∧
      planeJacobian (W.chart z m) p ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < W.height z m p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ frontier (physicalPieceOpen S W z m),
      CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) p) := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, physicalPieceClosed, canonicalClosed, hi] using
        hK.boundary z hz hs (if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1)
  | inr i =>
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, physicalPieceClosed, canonicalClosed, hi] using
        (hpositive i).boundary_fields (n04PositiveComponent_bounds hf i).2.1

include hK hz hs hpositive in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_reflection (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N

/-!
# Normalization of the single whole-component atlas

Restrict the old normalization set to the reference-only buffered set.
The negative fields are unchanged; each positive normalization point lies
in the actual identity middle for both the current and reference maps.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_normalization
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    {U : Set ℝ} (B : N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer D.a D.b (deriv D.w) U)
    {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hK : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (hf : Continuous (deriv D.w)) (hN : B.region ⊆ K.normalizationRegion)
    (href : (C.referenceState, 0) ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε ∧
      stateSector S C.referenceState)
    (hpositive : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 → ∀ i,
      WholePositiveChartGeometry (F z i) (G z i)
        (wholePositiveChartHeight (F z i) (Q z i))
        (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) (B.centerLeft i) (B.centerRight i))
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q B.region
    physicalPieceOpen S W z m ∩ (W.normalizationRegion ×ˢ univ) =
      physicalPieceOpen S W (C.referenceState, 0) m ∩ (W.normalizationRegion ×ˢ univ) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S W z m, p.1 ∈ W.normalizationRegion →
      W.chart z m p = W.chart (C.referenceState, 0) m p ∧
      W.height z m p = W.height (C.referenceState, 0) m p := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      let k := if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
      have hbase := hK.normalization z hz hs k
      have hprod : B.region ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ K.normalizationRegion ×ˢ univ :=
        fun _ hp => ⟨hN hp.1, hp.2⟩
      have hinter : (K.normalizationRegion ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∩
          (B.region ×ˢ univ) = B.region ×ˢ univ := inter_eq_right.mpr hprod
      have heq := congrArg (fun A : Set PolarPoint => A ∩ (B.region ×ˢ univ)) hbase.1
      have hrestricted :
          physicalPieceOpen S K z k ∩ (B.region ×ˢ univ) =
          physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState, 0) k ∩ (B.region ×ˢ univ) := by
        simpa only [inter_assoc, hinter] using heq
      have hvalues : ∀ p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S K z k, p.1 ∈ B.region →
          K.chart z k p = K.chart (C.referenceState, 0) k p ∧
          K.height z k p = K.height (C.referenceState, 0) k p :=
        fun p hp hn => hbase.2 p hp (hN hn)
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, hi, k] using And.intro hrestricted hvalues
  | inr i =>
      have hvalues :
          ∀ p ∈ Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ),
          p.1 ∈ B.region →
          F z i p = F (C.referenceState, 0) i p ∧
          wholePositiveChartHeight (F z i) (Q z i) p =
            wholePositiveChartHeight (F (C.referenceState, 0) i)
              (Q (C.referenceState, 0) i) p := by
        intro p hp hn
        exact B.chart_height_normalization hf i (hpositive z hz hs i)
          (hpositive (C.referenceState, 0) href.1 href.2 i) hp hn
      have hdomain :
          (Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∩
            (B.region ×ˢ univ) =
          (Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∩
            (B.region ×ˢ univ) := rfl
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, hi] using And.intro hdomain hvalues

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# The actual moving partition with whole positive components

The negative domains are the same genuine travel halves. Each original
positive subdivision is contained in its full positive component. The
old planar null set therefore still gives coverage; actual negative-half
uniqueness, component disjointness and the two signs give uniqueness.
No radial graph is assigned to a moving cut.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set MeasureTheory
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

variable {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
  {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
  (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
  (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
  (e₀ : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ)

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    physicalPieceOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) z m =
      match e m with
      | .inl j => n04bTypedPhysicalDomain (D := D) C (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z) (.inl j)
      | .inr i => Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ univ := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      have h := (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_negative_fields C L
        (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N z m j hi).2.2.2.2.1
      rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
      cases side <;> simpa only [n04bActualTypedAtlas,
        n04bTypedAtlasData_cutPair, n04bTypedAtlasData_physicalPieceOpen,
        Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
  | inr i =>
      exact (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_positive_fields C L
        (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N z m i hi).2.2.2.2.1

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain_index_unique
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) {m n : ℕ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hm : p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) z m)
    (hn : p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) z n) : m = n := by
  have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
  have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) :=
    (n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN).2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  have hΓ (j : ℕ) : MapsTo (n04bActualTravelChart S C L z j)
      (Ioo (C.left j) (C.right j) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
      (Ioo 0 (C.travel j) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    (n04b_actualTravelChart_bijOn hN hS hT hfield hz hs j).mapsTo
  rw [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N] at hm hn
  apply e.injective
  cases him : e m with
  | inl i =>
      cases hin : e n with
      | inl j =>
          simp only [him, hin] at hm hn
          have hij : i = j := Sum.inl.inj
            (n04b_typed_domain_index_unique hf hC hΓ hm hn)
          exact congrArg Sum.inl hij
      | inr j =>
          simp only [him, hin] at hm hn
          exact (lt_asymm
            (n04b_typed_domain_negative hC (.inl i) rfl hm)
            (n04PositiveComponent_interval_pos hf j hn.1)).elim
  | inr i =>
      cases hin : e n with
      | inl j =>
          simp only [him, hin] at hm hn
          exact (lt_asymm
            (n04PositiveComponent_interval_pos hf i hm.1)
            (n04b_typed_domain_negative hC (.inl j) rfl hn)).elim
      | inr j =>
          simp only [him, hin] at hm hn
          have hij : i = j := by
            by_contra hne
            exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
              (n04PositiveComponent_interval_pairwiseDisjoint hf hne) hm.1 hn.1
          exact congrArg Sum.inr hij

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_partition
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L
      (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    ∃ E : Set PolarPoint, volume E = 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ annularOpen D \ E, ∃! m, p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S W z m := by
  have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) :=
    (n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN).2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hcover⟩ := n04b_actual_typed_domain_partition hT hS hN hfield hz hs
  refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := hcover p hp
  have hex : ∃ m, p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S
      (n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀)
        e cell F G Q N) z m := by
    cases i with
    | inl j =>
        refine ⟨e.symm (.inl j), ?_⟩
        rw [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hi
    | inr j =>
        refine ⟨e.symm (.inr j.1), ?_⟩
        rw [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact ⟨n04_positive_piece_mem_component hf j hi.1, mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨m, hm, fun n hn => n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_domain_index_unique
    hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N hz hs hn hm⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Reference signs and current domain fields for the whole atlas

The negative flags are those of the original actual cut pairs. Positive
pieces are the genuine full positive intervals, including those that
touch an ambient endpoint. All fields refer to the same atlas record.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

private theorem wholeAtlas_old_negative_flag
    {S : PhysicalSpacesData} {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    (hcut : CanonicalReferenceCutPairs S C K) (j : ℕ × Bool) :
    K.positive (if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1) = false := by
  rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
  cases side
  · exact (hcut j).1
  · exact (hcut j).2.1

variable {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
  (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
  (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
  (N : Set ℝ) {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hK : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
  (hcut : CanonicalReferenceCutPairs S C K) (hf : Continuous (deriv D.w))

include hK hf in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referenceBounds (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.physicalLeft m < W.physicalRight m ∧ W.left m < W.right m ∧

  cases hi : e m with

      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision, hi] using
        And.intro hb.2.1 (And.intro hb.2.1 hsub)

include hf in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referencePositive (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.positive m = true →
      ∀ r ∈ Ioo (W.physicalLeft m) (W.physicalRight m), 0 < deriv D.w r := by
  dsimp only
  intro hp r hr

  | inl j =>

        n04WholePiecePositive, hi, Bool.false_eq_true] at hp

include hK hcut in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referenceNegative (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.positive m = false →
      ∀ r ∈ Ioo (W.physicalLeft m) (W.physicalRight m), deriv D.w r < 0 := by
  dsimp only
  intro hp r hr
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      apply hK.referenceNegative
        (if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1)

include hK hcut hf in
theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_domains
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    let Ω := physicalPieceOpen S W z m
    IsOpen Ω ∧ Ω.Nonempty ∧ Ω ⊆ annularOpen D ∧
    (∀ p : PolarPoint, p + (0, Real.pi) ∈ Ω ↔ p ∈ Ω) ∧
    (∀ p : PolarPoint, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ Ω ↔ p ∈ Ω) ∧
    (W.positive m = true → Ω = referencePhysicalPieceOpen S W m) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ Ω, W.positive m = true → 0 < deriv D.w p.1) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ Ω, W.positive m = false → deriv D.w p.1 < 0) := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      have hneg := wholeAtlas_old_negative_flag hcut j
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, referencePhysicalPieceOpen, n04WholePiecePositive, hi, hneg] using
        hK.domains z hz hs (if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1)
  | inr i =>
      let Ω := Ioo (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)
      have hb := n04PositiveComponent_bounds hf i
      have hnonempty : Ω.Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_between hb.2.1
        exact ⟨(x, 0), hx, mem_univ _⟩
      have hfields : IsOpen Ω ∧ Ω.Nonempty ∧ Ω ⊆ annularOpen D ∧
          (∀ p : PolarPoint, p + (0, Real.pi) ∈ Ω ↔ p ∈ Ω) ∧
          (∀ p : PolarPoint, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ Ω ↔ p ∈ Ω) ∧
          (true = true → Ω = Ω) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Ω, true = true → 0 < deriv D.w p.1) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Ω, true = false → deriv D.w p.1 < 0) := by
        refine ⟨isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ, hnonempty, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro p hp
          exact ⟨⟨hb.1.trans_lt hp.1.1, hp.1.2.trans_le hb.2.2⟩, mem_univ _⟩
        · intro p
          simp only [Ω, mem_prod, Prod.fst_add, add_zero, mem_univ, and_true]
        · intro p
          rfl
        · intro _
          rfl
        · intro p hp _
          exact n04PositiveComponent_interval_pos hf i hp.1
        · intro p hp hfalse
          cases hfalse
      simpa only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        physicalPieceOpen, referencePhysicalPieceOpen, n04WholePiecePositive, hi, Ω] using hfields

The old optical cut supplies the exact negative reference radii. Whole
positive components supply the remaining intervals. Their already proved
countable reference exception gives the radial null-set partition.

variable {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
  {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
  {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
  (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
  (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
  (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)

  (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
    N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L
      (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    W.physicalLeft m = n04WholePieceLeft C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) ∧
      W.physicalRight m = n04WholePieceRight C (n04bActualReferenceCut hN) (e m) := by
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
      cases side <;> simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData, n04bCanonicalOperatorData,
        n04bReferenceMetadata, n04bReferencePieces, n04bReferenceTypedLeft,
        n04bReferenceTypedRight, n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight, hi,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, and_self]
  | inr i =>
      simp only [n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData, n04bWithInteriorDivision,
        n04WholePieceLeft, n04WholePieceRight, hi, and_self]

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_referencePartition :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L
      (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀) e cell F G Q N
    ∃ E : Set ℝ, volume E = 0 ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo D.a D.b \ E,
      ∃! m, r ∈ Ioo (W.physicalLeft m) (W.physicalRight m) := by
  have hD := n04b_profileGeometry_of_through03 hN
  have hf : Continuous (deriv D.w) := hD.2.2.1.1.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
  have hcut : ∀ m, n04bActualReferenceCut hN m ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) :=
    n04bActualReferenceCut_mem hN
  refine ⟨n04WholePieceExceptional D (n04bActualReferenceCut hN),
    (n04WholePieceExceptional_countable hD).measure_zero volume, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ := n04WholePiece_cover hf hC hcut hr
  refine ⟨e.symm i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrad := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii
      hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N (e.symm i)
    rw [hrad.1, hrad.2, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hi
  · intro n hn
    apply e.injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply hu
    have hrad := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_reference_radii
      hT hS hN hfield e₀ e cell F G Q N n
    rwa [hrad.1, hrad.2] at hn

theorem n04PositiveNormalizationBuffer_region_subset_actualNormalization
    {U : Set ℝ} (B : N04PositiveNormalizationBuffer D.a D.b (deriv D.w) U)
    (hf : Continuous (deriv D.w)) :
    B.region ⊆ (n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀).normalizationRegion := by
  change B.region ⊆ n04bNormalizationRegion D
  have hclosed : closure {r : ℝ | deriv D.w r < 0} ⊆ {r : ℝ | deriv D.w r ≤ 0} :=
    closure_minimal (fun _ hr => hr.le) (isClosed_le hf continuous_const)
  intro r hr
  exact fun hneg => (not_le_of_gt (B.region_subset_positive hf hr).2) (hclosed hneg)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_geometry
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}

    CanonicalGeometry D S C

  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e₀

  refine {

    referenceBounds := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referenceBounds

    referencePositive := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referencePositive

    referenceNegative := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_referenceNegative

    partition := fun z hz hs => n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_actual_partition

/-!
# Transmission for the actual stored negative charts

The two inverse and height germs are supplied by the actual atlas
construction. Their common physical point is the middle of the genuine
travel strip. The constructed root-height identity gives both frozen
transmission conditions for every smooth physical test function.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open scoped ContDiff
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

theorem n04ActualAtlas_transmission
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    {z : AnnularState S × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε)
    (hs : stateSector S z.1) (u : PolarPoint → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    let Wl := canonicalHeight S K z (K.cutPair m).1 u
    let Wr := canonicalHeight S K z (K.cutPair m).2 u
    Wr (K.cutRadius m, θ) = Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) ∧
      radialPartial Wr (K.cutRadius m, θ) =
        -radialPartial Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) -
          Wl (K.cutRadius m, θ) / (2 * K.cutRadius m) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let X := n04bActualTravelInverse S C L z m
  have hpos := n04b_actualTravel_positive hN hS hT hfield hz hs m
  have hmid : (C.travel m / 2, θ) ∈
      Ioo (0 : ℝ) (C.travel m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
    ⟨⟨half_pos hpos, half_lt_self hpos⟩, mem_univ _⟩
  have hX := n04b_actualTravelInverse_spec hN hS hT hfield hz hs m
  have hx : X (C.travel m / 2, θ) ∈
      Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := hX.1 hmid
  have hcontrol : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.1.1.2.2.2.1
  have hxD : X (C.travel m / 2, θ) ∈ annularOpen D :=
    ⟨⟨(hcontrol.1 m).1.trans hx.1.1, hx.1.2.trans (hcontrol.1 m).2.2⟩,
      mem_univ _⟩
  have hXa : DifferentiableAt ℝ X (C.travel m / 2, θ) :=
    (hX.2.2.2.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hmid)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have ha := (hfield.smooth_coefficients z hz hs).1.contDiffAt
    ((isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hxD)
  have hv := (n04b_corrected_characteristics_contDiffAt hN hfield hz hs m hx).2.1
  have hg := n04bActualTypedAtlas_cut_germs hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m θ
  have ht := n04b_canonicalHeight_constructedRoot_cut K z
    (fun side => e.symm (.inl (m, side))) (L.coefficients z)
    (n04bCharacteristicHalfGap (L.coefficients z)) hpos θ hX.2.2.1 hXa
    (ha.differentiableAt (by simp)) (hv.differentiableAt (by simp))
    (hfield.positive_a z hz hs _ hxD)
    (n04b_actualCharacteristic_halfGap_pos hN hfield hz hs m hx)
    hg.1 hg.2 u hu
  simpa only [K, n04bActualTypedAtlas, n04bTypedAtlasData_cutPair,
    n04bTypedAtlasData_cutRadius] using ht

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual operator fields of the whole-component atlas

The retained negative fields and the inserted positive fields both use
the same inverse-coordinate formulas. Establish that fact on the one
stored record, then apply the full coordinate operator identity with
physical regularity at its actual inverse image.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open scoped ContDiff
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint

theorem n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData_operatorFields
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (L : ReturnCorrectionData S) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (F G : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ) (hcut : CanonicalReferenceCutPairs S C K)
    (hfields : ∀ z m,
      K.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
        (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, K.potential z m p = (if K.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (K.chart z m) (K.inverseChart z m) (K.height z m) p)
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    let W := n04WholeCanonicalAtlasData C L K e cell F G Q N
    W.coefficients z m = inverseChartPrincipalCoefficients (L.coefficients z)
      (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) ∧
      ∀ p, W.potential z m p = (if W.positive m then -1 else (1 : ℝ)) *
        inverseChartPotential (L.coefficients z)
          (W.chart z m) (W.inverseChart z m) (W.height z m) p := by
  dsimp only
  cases hi : e m with
  | inl j =>
      let k := if j.2 then (K.cutPair j.1).2 else (K.cutPair j.1).1
      have hneg : K.positive k = false := by
        rcases j with ⟨j, side⟩
